items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: I put people together that had never been together before to see if the sparks would fly, and it really worked beautifully. Like Phyllis Diller and Irwin Corey.

ctx.x: Maybe some of your routines came out of that downtime.

I think a lot of them did. Because I’ve never been able to write. Oddly enough now I could write for TV, for sketches because I did a series in Toronto called Pete’s Place. It took place in Vegas but we shot it in Toronto. And the deal was I had a small club off the strip in Vegas and everything went wrong that could go wrong with the club you know. The mob tried to move in and this and that. And so I asked a bunch of my friends to come up and I put people together that had never been together before to see if…
